Three people travelling from Enugu to Abuja were reportedly abducted on Saturday around Oglewu in Ohimini Local Government Area of Benue State. According to a source in the area, the vehicle was intercepted by suspected gunmen at about 9:30 pm on Saturday. “Some gunmen intercepted a commercial bus travelling to Abuja along Otukpo-Oweto Highway Saturday night. “The incident occurred on Saturday at about 9:25 pm when certain persons were said to be travelling from Enugu and intercepted as the driver of the vehicle was shot, three passengers kidnapped, one allegedly escaped but later found,” the source, who did not want to be named, said in a telephone interview on Sunday. The spokesperson for the Benue State Police Command, DSP Peter Aondongu, who confirmed the incident in a telephone interview on Sunday night, said the driver, who was shot, was receiving treatment at the Teaching Hospital in Otukpo. Six people who were conveying the corpse of a woman were kidnapped along the road the previous week. They were later reported to have been released a few days after a payment of N2.5m. John Charles
